## Activity

During April 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 267 captures. Activity was delivered through the clinic’s routine session arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded total represents the number of captures completed during the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 267 captures, 8 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 3.0 per cent. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images could not be progressed through the usual grading process and are reported separately from the grading outcomes.

## Grading

Grading identified 50 referable results from the captures completed during April 2021. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure reflects the midpoint of the recorded interval between image capture and completion of grading. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a summary of the clinic’s operational performance for the month. Routine leave was the only exception noted in the session lists, and no other disruption to planned activity was recorded.
